// GENERATED by npm run build:n8n. Edit the source helpers, not this file.
/** Adapter for a canonical mapped event, not an export of the existing workflow.
 * No credentials or live record IDs belong in this file.
 * Paste into an authorized n8n Code node only after mapping the actual output.
 */
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- n8n Code nodes use CommonJS.
const { createHmac } = require("crypto");
function prepareCrmRequest(input, secret, now = Date.now()) {
  if (typeof secret !== "string" || secret.length < 32)
    throw new Error("CRM_SECRET_MISSING");
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || Array.isArray(input))
    throw new Error("CRM_EVENT_REQUIRED");
  if (input.organization_id !== undefined)
    throw new Error("ORGANIZATION_IS_SERVER_CONFIGURED");
  for (const key of [
    "event_id",
    "external_id",
    "brand_id",
    "source",
    "occurred_at",
  ]) {
    if (typeof input[key] !== "string" || !input[key].trim())
      throw new Error(`CRM_FIELD_REQUIRED:${key}`);
  }
  if (input.event_id.length > 160 || input.external_id.length > 160)
    throw new Error("CRM_ID_TOO_LONG");
  if (typeof input.is_test !== "boolean")
    throw new Error("CRM_TEST_FLAG_REQUIRED");
  if (
    !input.contact ||
    typeof input.contact.name !== "string" ||
    !input.contact.name.trim()
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_CONTACT_REQUIRED");
  let score = input.score ?? null;
  if (typeof score === "string" && /^\d{1,3}$/.test(score.trim()))
    score = Number(score.trim());
  const classification =
    input.classification == null
      ? null
      : String(input.classification).trim().toUpperCase();
  const evaluatedAt = input.evaluated_at ?? null;
  if (
    !(score === null && classification === null && evaluatedAt === null) &&
    !(
      Number.isInteger(score) &&
      score >= 0 &&
      score <= 100 &&
      ["HOT", "WARM", "COLD"].includes(classification) &&
      typeof evaluatedAt === "string"
    )
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_EVALUATION_INCOMPLETE");
  const text = (key) => {
    const value = input[key];
    if (value == null) return "";
    if (typeof value === "string") return value;
    if (key === "budget" && typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value))
      return String(value);
    throw new Error(`CRM_TEXT_FIELD:${key}`);
  };
  if (
    input.priority != null &&
    (typeof input.priority !== "string" || input.priority.length > 50)
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_PRIORITY_INVALID");
  if (input.route_to_sales != null && typeof input.route_to_sales !== "boolean")
    throw new Error("CRM_ROUTE_FLAG_INVALID");
  const breakdown = input.scoring_breakdown ?? {};
  if (
    !breakdown ||
    typeof breakdown !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(breakdown) ||
    Object.keys(breakdown).length > 20 ||
    Object.entries(breakdown).some(
      ([k, v]) =>
        !k ||
        k.length > 100 ||
        typeof v !== "number" ||
        !Number.isFinite(v) ||
        v < 0 ||
        v > 100,
    )
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_BREAKDOWN_INVALID");
  const event = {
    type: "lead.created",
    event_id: input.event_id,
    external_id: input.external_id,
    brand_id: input.brand_id,
    contact: {
      name: input.contact.name,
      company: input.contact.company ?? "",
      email: input.contact.email ?? "",
      phone: input.contact.phone ?? "",
    },
    source: input.source,
    campaign: text("campaign"),
    monthly_leads: input.monthly_leads ?? null,
    capture_context: input.capture_context ?? null,
    message: text("message"),
    budget: text("budget"),
    urgency: text("urgency"),
    service: text("service"),
    need: text("need"),
    score,
    classification,
    priority: input.priority ?? null,
    route_to_sales: input.route_to_sales ?? null,
    response_suggestion: text("response_suggestion"),
    scoring_breakdown: breakdown,
    problem: text("problem"),
    opportunity: text("opportunity"),
    recommendation: text("recommendation"),
    next_action: text("next_action"),
    occurred_at: input.occurred_at,
    evaluated_at: evaluatedAt,
    is_test: input.is_test,
  };
  const body = JSON.stringify(event);
  if (Buffer.byteLength(body, "utf8") > 32768)
    throw new Error("CRM_EVENT_TOO_LARGE");
  const timestamp = String(Math.floor(now / 1000));
  const signature = createHmac("sha256", secret)
    .update(timestamp + "." + body)
    .digest("hex");
  return {
    body,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-CRM-Timestamp": timestamp,
      "X-CRM-Signature": "sha256=" + signature,
    },
  };
}

/** Dot paths are explicit configuration; never eval model output or guess field names. */
function prepareMappedCrmRequest(source, mapping, secret, now = Date.now()) {
  const fields = [
    "event_id",
    "external_id",
    "brand_id",
    "source",
    "campaign",
    "monthly_leads",
    "capture_context",
    "message",
    "budget",
    "urgency",
    "service",
    "need",
    "score",
    "classification",
    "priority",
    "route_to_sales",
    "response_suggestion",
    "scoring_breakdown",
    "problem",
    "opportunity",
    "recommendation",
    "next_action",
    "occurred_at",
    "evaluated_at",
    "is_test",
    "contact.name",
    "contact.company",
    "contact.email",
    "contact.phone",
  ];
  if (!mapping || mapping.version !== 1) throw new Error("CRM_MAPPING_VERSION");
  const paths = mapping.paths || {};
  const constants = mapping.constants || {};
  for (const field of [...Object.keys(paths), ...Object.keys(constants)])
    if (!fields.includes(field)) throw new Error("CRM_UNKNOWN_MAPPING_FIELD");
  const event = { contact: {} };
  for (const field of fields) {
    let value;
    if (Object.hasOwn(constants, field) && constants[field] !== null)
      value = constants[field];
    else if (paths[field] != null) {
      if (typeof paths[field] !== "string" || !paths[field])
        throw new Error("CRM_INVALID_FIELD_PATH");
      value = source;
      for (const part of paths[field].split(".")) {
        if (["__proto__", "prototype", "constructor"].includes(part))
          throw new Error("CRM_UNSAFE_FIELD_PATH");
        value =
          value && typeof value === "object" && Object.hasOwn(value, part)
            ? value[part]
            : undefined;
      }
    }
    if (value !== undefined) {
      if (field.startsWith("contact.")) event.contact[field.slice(8)] = value;
      else event[field] = value;
    }
  }
  return prepareCrmRequest(event, secret, now);
}

/** Confirmed flat Code in JavaScript output + explicit n8n transport context.
 * No model parsing, invented contact data or identity based on email/name.
 */
function normalizeN8nLead(lead, context) {
  if (!lead || typeof lead !== "object" || Array.isArray(lead))
    throw new Error("CRM_FLAT_LEAD_REQUIRED");
  if (!context || typeof context !== "object")
    throw new Error("CRM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED");
  for (const key of [
    "workflow_id",
    "execution_id",
    "brand_id",
    "observed_at",
  ]) {
    if (typeof context[key] !== "string" || !context[key].trim())
      throw new Error(`CRM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED:${key}`);
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(context.item_index) || context.item_index < 0)
    throw new Error("CRM_ITEM_INDEX_REQUIRED");
  if (typeof context.is_test !== "boolean")
    throw new Error("CRM_TEST_FLAG_REQUIRED");
  if (lead.is_test !== undefined && typeof lead.is_test !== "boolean")
    throw new Error("CRM_SOURCE_TEST_FLAG_INVALID");
  const date = (value) =>
    typeof value === "string" &&
    /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})$/.test(value) &&
    Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value));
  for (const key of ["observed_at", "captured_at", "evaluated_at"])
    if (context[key] != null && !date(context[key]))
      throw new Error(`CRM_CONTEXT_DATE:${key}`);
  if (
    context.source_event_id != null &&
    (typeof context.source_event_id !== "string" ||
      !context.source_event_id.trim() ||
      context.source_event_id.length > 500)
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_SOURCE_ID_INVALID");
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- n8n Code nodes use CommonJS.
  const { createHash } = require("crypto");
  const digest = (value) =>
    createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest("hex");
  const executionKey = digest([
    context.workflow_id,
    context.execution_id,
    context.item_index,
  ]);
  const sourceKey = context.source_event_id
    ? digest([lead.source, context.source_event_id])
    : null;
  const optionalText = (key) => {
    const value = lead[key];
    if (value == null) return "";
    if (typeof value === "string") return value;
    if (key === "budget" && typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value))
      return String(value);
    throw new Error(`CRM_FLAT_TEXT:${key}`);
  };
  const monthly = lead.monthly_leads ?? null;
  if (
    monthly !== null &&
    !(typeof monthly === "string" && monthly.length <= 300) &&
    !(
      typeof monthly === "number" &&
      Number.isSafeInteger(monthly) &&
      monthly >= 0
    )
  )
    throw new Error("CRM_MONTHLY_LEADS_INVALID");
  const hasEvaluation = lead.lead_score != null || lead.classification != null;
  return {
    type: "lead.created",
    event_id: "n8n-execution:" + executionKey,
    external_id: sourceKey
      ? "source-event:" + sourceKey
      : "n8n-execution:" + executionKey,
    brand_id: context.brand_id,
    contact: {
      name: lead.name,
      email: optionalText("email"),
      phone: optionalText("phone"),
      company: optionalText("company"),
    },
    source: lead.source,
    service: optionalText("service_interest"),
    message: optionalText("message"),
    monthly_leads: monthly,
    budget: optionalText("budget"),
    urgency: optionalText("urgency"),
    score: lead.lead_score ?? null,
    classification: lead.classification ?? null,
    priority: lead.priority ?? null,
    route_to_sales: lead.route_to_sales ?? null,
    problem: optionalText("main_problem"),
    opportunity: optionalText("commercial_opportunity"),
    recommendation: optionalText("recommended_action"),
    response_suggestion: optionalText("response_suggestion"),
    scoring_breakdown: lead.scoring_breakdown ?? {},
    next_action: "",
    occurred_at: context.captured_at || context.observed_at,
    evaluated_at: hasEvaluation
      ? context.evaluated_at || context.observed_at
      : null,
    capture_context: {
      identity_scope: sourceKey ? "source_event" : "n8n_execution",
      capture_time_source: context.captured_at ? "source" : "n8n_observed",
      evaluation_time_source: hasEvaluation
        ? context.evaluated_at
          ? "source"
          : "n8n_observed"
        : null,
    },
    is_test:
      context.is_test ||
      lead.is_test === true ||
      (context.execution_mode != null &&
        context.execution_mode !== "production"),
  };
}

// n8n Code node: Run Once for All Items. No secret values belong in this artifact.
const mode = $env.CRM_CAPTURE_IS_TEST;
if (mode !== 'true' && mode !== 'false') throw new Error('CRM_TEST_MODE_REQUIRED');
const observedAt = $now.toISO();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({
  json: prepareCrmRequest(normalizeN8nLead(item.json, {
    workflow_id: $workflow.id, execution_id: $execution.id, item_index: index,
    brand_id: $env.CRM_BRAND_ID, observed_at: observedAt, is_test: mode === 'true', execution_mode: $execution.mode || 'unknown'
  }), $env.CRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
}));
